result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Client retains ownership of its IP and data; Client owns specifically commissioned work product through a present assignment; embedded TrueLink IP is subject to a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence; and joint ownership is expressly disclaimed. TrueLink’s retained ownership of the Interface and the treatment of embedded TrueLink IP as licensed rather than assigned adequately preserve its pre-existing IP. The addition is targeted and preserves the existing commercial structure. Drafting is professional, though the embedded-IP licence is limited to use as part of the work product in Client’s ordinary-course business, and the surrounding inherited text contains structural defects such as duplicate subsection lettering and fragments.
